claims.claim: Learned early stopping's gain over matched random restarting (up to 1.98 pp) comes from between-task allocation, not within-task attempt selection, and continuation dominates restarts.

claims.quoted_support: an exact decomposition proving that learned stopping's gain over matched random restarting (up to 1.98 percentage points) stems from between-task stopping allocation rather than within-task attempt selection
